descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · TFA-94699 AC 6; UAT TC-24 ER · “Every delete asks for confirmation once; no bulk delete”. Mixed: stated part — A single delete asks for confirmation and removes only that point; no delete-all; our part — Double tap on delete, a blank point, a double-clicked Save Point (only the stated part makes a QA bug).

Candidate N49 · proposed S2 · a new finding waiting for Quinn's confirmation, not counted yet

Deleting an Important Point (one tap on Delete point) asks no confirmation

Tickets: TFA-94699 AC 6 (in progress) · counts as a QA bug: to confirm · found on: dev + local (8b4be94a)

Note: Local, both modes. TFA-94699 is in progress.

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-24/S19

Approach · TC-12 Important Points · S25 Deleting a point asks once and a double tap removes at most one; a blank or double-clicked Save Point adds nothing extra (both modes)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T4 Every delete asks for confirmation once; there is no bulk delete. (TFA-94699 AC 6) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U4 Editing one point and deleting another both work, in both modes, and the result is what is stored. (UAT TC-12; TFA-92590 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • U2 Three points added via '+ Add Point', one per line, show as three separate cards, not one merged card, in both Hospital and Nursing Home (Nursing Home per PR #57). (UAT TC-12; TFA-92590 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • T5 Points are stored exactly as typed: text, case, punctuation, symbols and spacing, one card per typed point, nothing added. Deterministic: any single mismatch fails and is quoted typed vs stored; … (TFA-92590 AC 4; TFA-92590 description) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • U7 Every step is repeated in Nursing Home and must pass in both modes. (UAT TC-12; UAT 3.3; TFA-92590 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Hospital patient and Nursing Home resident, each seeded with three points

When In each mode: tap Delete point on the first card once; then confirm; then double-tap Delete point on the second card and confirm once. Then Add Point with only spaces and Save Point; Add Point 'Double-tap check' and double-click Save Point

Then A single tap shows a confirmation and the point is still listed; after confirming only that point is gone; the double tap removes only the second point; there is no delete-all; the blank point makes no card; the double-clicked Save Point makes exactly one 'Double-tap check' card

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): TFA-94699 AC 6 (whether it covers points is Q7); main deletes on one tap: expected Fail. backendChecks after the run, each mode: texts == ['Delete-check three', 'Double-tap check'] exactly (count 2: no blank card, one 'Double-tap check' card; T5)

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S25 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-12.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 0 rows.
